mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL annualized change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,500.0 (thousands of units), it signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening labor market coupled with monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
